name: Marshal Windsor
label: Quest
description: Marshal Windsor: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So that good for nothing coward says that Windsor is alive, eh?
Suit up, deputy, you are going in to find him. If Windsor is alive, you are to bring him back. If he's dead, I want proof.
I bet you are getting tired of hearing that, aren't you?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Where is he! I'll murder him!
